notes.title: Demo is Back Online!
notes.content:
Hello Players of Swing Swamp!

Thank you all for your continued interest. Based on the original Demo version, we have:
[list]
[*] Expanded the playable content.
[*] Added mini side quests.
[*] Polished guidance and hints.
[*] Introduced a new enemy type – the Boomerang Fish.
[*] Added Aim Assist.
[/list]
We've also added new weapons and other enemy variations, which will be revealed in the full release!

Once again, thank you for your attention and anticipation. We hope to bring the full Swamp experience to you as soon as possible!

notes.title: Demo Vol.1 Update notes 2025-02-25
notes.content:
[p]Thank you everyone for playing our demo! In response to recurring feedback, we've implemented a quick update to the demo version with the following changes:

[/p][list][*][p] Added background sound for character dialogues
[/p][/*][*][p] Modified slug model's color and adjusted silk damage
[/p][/*][*][p] Reduced the threat of boom enemies
[/p][/*][*][p] Optimized level design flow, added silk sac anchor points' traversal routes, and improved enemy quantity/distribution
[/p][/*][*][p] Added screen mode options in settings menu
[/p][/*][*][p] Enhanced grappling hook control responsiveness
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Happy gaming![/p]
